scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic and dimension independent. No numerical experiment is used as proof. The defining and question-posing arXiv full texts were inspected; a later 2015 preservers paper was available only at abstract level and is recorded as a residual literature risk.
scientific.limitations: The monotonicity theorem is for finite-dimensional state-preserving Hilbert--Schmidt orthogonal projections, including nonselective projective measurements. It does not apply to arbitrary quantum channels or to selective branchwise monotonicity.

title: Projective coarse-graining is monotone for superfidelity
